usage.callShape: Registry lists POST https://x402helper.xyz/api/proxy/luma-ray-2-flash-image-to-video-fast-2 but POST returns Express 404. Only GET returns a 402 quote; GET pays then refunds with no result.
usage.outputShape: No usable output. GET response: body.success=false, body.refunded=true, body.message="Price mismatch, you have been refunded", body.refundTx. POST response: Express 404 HTML.
quirks: POST (the registered method) returns Express 404 'Cannot POST /api/proxy/luma-ray-2-flash-image-to-video-fast-2' — the route does not accept POST.
Only GET returns a 402 payment quote (amount 13000 = $0.013 USDC on Base).
Paying the GET charges $0.013 then immediately refunds on-chain with {success:false, refunded:true, message:'Price mismatch, you have been refunded', refundTx:...} and returns NO video.
Underlying proxy target is obolos.tech (per 402 resource.description) — appears misconfigured/dead.
Do NOT retry: route is broken; GET wastes gas via charge-then-refund and POST 404s.
usage.guide: This endpoint is broken and should not be used. The registered POST method returns an Express 404 ('Cannot POST'); only GET returns a 402 payment quote. Paying the GET ($0.013 USDC on Base) results in an immediate on-chain refund with message 'Price mismatch, you have been refunded' and no generated video — the underlying obolos.tech proxy is misconfigured. There is no working call shape; do not attempt to use this for image-to-video generation.
